correctness.rationale: A hub fire exactly regenerates the all-vacant state. Independent pre-hub leaf birth-death and post-hub killed pure-birth paths give the exact two-integral fire-size law and its coefficient functional. A uniform leaf law of large numbers with lambda=c/n yields the explicit time-changed hazard and survival, and the density follows by substitution. A uniform exponential-convolution tail at fixed c justifies renewal-reward stationarity; exchangeability gives the limiting pair covariance as a positive variance. Endpoint limits follow from the conditional hazard bounds. An independent rational CTMC agrees with the polynomial-integral formula for 30 n,lambda test cases; this finite check is not invoked as proof of the infinite-size claims.

originality.rationale: A bounded, statement-level comparison found no equivalent or dominating statement of the exact marked hub-fire law, the nondegenerate critical n*lambda regime, and the stationary persistent-leaf covariance. Volkov addresses one-sided ignition on the infinite half-line; Graf addresses fixed-degree rooted trees with depth tending to infinity; Stahl proves stationary existence on Zd; van den Berg and Brouwer study finite boxes and critical times. The most closely related public reset finding has an independent, constant-rate catastrophe clock rather than an occupied-hub-gated intensity lambda(1+K). Historical priority is provisional; the original 1992 article was accessible only as an abstract and unindexed prior star work could exist.
residual_risks: The original 1992 Physical Review Letters paper could not be read beyond its accessible abstract; no claim of document-wide exclusion is made.
An unindexed specialized forest-fire result for growing-degree stars or a general state-dependent reset process might imply part of the distribution or stationary correlation results.
The bounded literature and published-finding corpus searches are not a certification of publication priority or mathematical independence.

value.rationale: The star provides a natural high-degree collective-burning laboratory: the single hub is a genuine stochastic gate for macroscopic fires, and aggregate lightning n*lambda competes with O(1) regrowth. The exact fire-fraction density and simultaneous stationary leaf-correlation law explain two distinct observation ensembles and a nontrivial uniform-fraction endpoint with nonvanishing covariance 1/12. These are motivated infinite-family statistical-mechanics facts, not a small finite enumeration or coefficient substitution; direct generality beyond this model is not claimed.
